nested_projects.note: separate yarn.lock; not part of root workspaces globs

lfs_note: No .gitattributes in repo. git-lfs filters are configured only in the user global ~/.gitconfig (filter.lfs.required=true) — no effect on this repo.
generated_paths: **/report*.api.md (API Extractor reports, regenerated by yarn build:api-reports)
regulated_repo_note: SECURITY.md is a standard OSS vulnerability-reporting policy (HackerOne/Discord), not a compliance regime. No HIPAA/PCI/SOC2/GDPR files or dirs; no compliance CODEOWNERS entries.

off_limits_rationale.docs/releases/**: AGENTS.md: never change release notes unless asked
off_limits_rationale..eslintrc.js / tsconfig.json / .prettier: AGENTS.md: never update ESLint/Prettier/TypeScript config unless requested
